decision_record.title: PHP API up to PHP 8.4 version

outcomes.outcome_text: Attribuer une fonctionnalité du langage à sa version d'introduction
outcomes.hash_method: Supplied current manifest; section hash not independently recomputed.
outcomes.observation: The course distinguishes introduction date from availability on target8.4. It explains named arguments/promotion/match/union/nullsafe/static return, then readonly property versus readonly class, never, first-class callables, final versus typed constants, DNF and Override. The mixed Price example needs8.4 for private(set), not for all its syntax; runtime prints12 EUR. All version-group questions preserve those distinctions, including ordinary dynamic-property deprecation rather than a blanket ban.

outcomes.outcome_text: Énumérer les cinq ajouts de langage de PHP 8.4
outcomes.hash_method: Supplied current manifest; section hash not independently recomputed.
outcomes.observation: Five selected8.4 mechanisms are explained without pretending to exhaust every release addition: property hooks, asymmetric visibility, lazy objects, native Deprecated and chained new. The ghost example produces0/LIVRE/1/CAHIER; get recalculates while initialization occurs once. A separate probe confirms short-set storage is backed, computed get is virtual and uncached, and native Deprecated produces E_USER_DEPRECATED without inherently becoming an exception.

outcomes.outcome_text: Distinguer readonly de la visibilité asymétrique private(set)
outcomes.hash_method: Supplied current manifest; section hash not independently recomputed.
outcomes.observation: The two dedicated questions distinguish write scope from write count; declaring-class currency updates USD→GBP→EUR are allowed while ordinary reassignment of readonly amount is not. Main explicitly says normal second assignment and links the detailed OOP readonly treatment; the earlier independently verified clone-reinitialization exception is not contradicted by the scoped ordinary-write scenario. Child initialization scope is dated8.4, not confused with public rewriting.

outcomes.outcome_text: Prévoir le résultat des functions d'array et des comparaisons PHP 8
outcomes.hash_method: Supplied current manifest; section hash not independently recomputed.
outcomes.observation: Main traces actual integer/string keys before merge/union, retained filter keys, numeric-string versus nonnumeric comparison and strict in_array. JSON object/array choice, legitimate null and thrown decoding error are distinguished. The full program's arrays, false/true/true/false booleans and2/invalid JSON outputs were executed; bank union prediction is exactly1 2. Nullable validation question correctly needs separate existence/key evidence rather than treating null as guaranteed absence.

outcomes.outcome_text: Attribuer les functions de la bibliothèque standard à leur version
outcomes.hash_method: Supplied current manifest; section hash not independently recomputed.
outcomes.observation: Value/key/existential/universal contracts are taught before choosing find/find_key/any/all. Callback value-then-key order, first match, null ambiguity, empty-array all=true and list-key order are explained and assessed. Function dates were independently checked from all eleven official function-version headers; mb_* also needs its extension, not only a sufficient PHP version. outcomes.hash_method: Supplied current manifest; section hash not independently recomputed.

outcomes.hash_method: Supplied current manifest; section hash not independently recomputed.
outcomes.observation: Private access is controlled by declaring class scope, not individual instance identity. Book::sameTitle accesses the other Book legally; asymmetric private(set) allows repeated internal renaming but rejects external writes. Main also distinguishes service-container public visibility from PHP member visibility.

outcomes.hash_method: Supplied current manifest; section hash not independently recomputed.

A promoted parameter default is not an illegal direct readonly property default. Main/trap/fiche distinguish ordinary reassignment, mutable referenced objects, PHP8.3 clone-time reinitialization and PHP8.4 child initialization; positive and negative runtime probes confirm those boundaries.

decision_record.title: HTTP status codes

outcomes.outcome_text: Identifier la class d'un status code à partir de son premier chiffre
outcomes.hash_method: Supplied current manifest; section hash not independently recomputed.

outcomes.hash_method: Supplied current manifest; section hash not independently recomputed.

outcomes.outcome_text: Distinguer les redirects préservant la method (307/308) des autres
outcomes.hash_method: Supplied current manifest; section hash not independently recomputed.

The purchase-confirmation example and coloured decision branches make that operational distinction, and the question does not promise target success.

outcomes.outcome_text: Distinguer 415 de 406 selon ce que le serveur refuse
outcomes.hash_method: Supplied current manifest; section hash not independently recomputed.

decision_record.title: HTTP methods

outcomes.outcome_text: Classer une method selon sûre, idempotente et cacheable
outcomes.hash_method: Supplied current manifest; section hash not independently recomputed.

A POST setting a fixed flag may be idempotent by contract; a PATCH assignment may be idempotent while an increment need not be. Neither yields a blanket method guarantee.

outcomes.hash_method: Supplied current manifest; section hash not independently recomputed.

outcomes.hash_method: Supplied current manifest; section hash not independently recomputed.
outcomes.observation: May/November and four development plus two stabilization months are explained as a planning mechanism. Unready features can be deferred; the worked November timeline rejects betting delivery on an unpublished API rather than merely reciting two month names.

outcomes.outcome_text: Énoncer les durées de maintenance standard et LTS
outcomes.hash_method: Supplied current manifest; section hash not independently recomputed.
outcomes.observation: Eight-month standard support versus three-year bugs/four-year security LTS are distinguished from migration overlap. The question rejects adding3+4 years and warns that actual branch dates must be checked for real decisions. Diagram counts both windows from release.

outcomes.hash_method: Supplied current manifest; section hash not independently recomputed.
